subject: Orchid Health CAIQ: control crosswalk + tenant sample extraction request
messages:
From: Alex Nguyen <alex@orchidhealth.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@orchidhealth.com
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ mapping + tenant sample request

Ethan,

Thanks for the quick sync earlier. As part of Orchid Health's security review ahead of procurement we'd like a CAIQ control crosswalk and a small set of runtime samples to validate isolation and telemetry claims. Specifically we need:

- A filled CAIQ spreadsheet with control narratives tied to Redwood controls (where possible include exact artifact names/paths).
- Two short date-ranged runtime samples showing: auth decision logs, API key rotation events, and a 1-hour token-level latency trace for a tenant-like workload.
- A statement about model routing fallbacks and whether fallback responses contain any tenant data.

Can you confirm what you can deliver by next Wednesday (2027-06-16)? We can accept redacted logs and a secure link for download.

Appreciate it,
Alex
Security Team, Orchid Health

----
Attachment: initial-question-set.pdf (stub)

From: Ethan Park <ethan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping + tenant sample request

Alex — thanks for the clear ask. We can put together a CAIQ crosswalk and provide redacted runtime artifacts. Plan below: 

1) CAIQ workbook: Kimberly will draft a control-by-control narrative (linking to our internal control ids) and populate the evidence column with artifact names. We will mark items that are design-level vs. operational and note where compensating controls apply.

2) Runtime samples: Marissa will prepare a 1-hour sample bundle from our sandbox tenant that includes auth logs, key rotation events, and a token-latency trace. We will redact tenant IDs and IPs before delivery.

3) Fallback behavior: We will include a short technical note explaining routing/fallback behavior and data leakage mitigations for model variants.

Deliverables and timing: CAIQ workbook + technical note by Tue 2027-06-15 EOD; redacted runtime bundle available via secure download by Wed 2027-06-16. If you need DocuSign or a confidentiality addendum, flag it and we can route it.

Kimberly/Marissa: can you pick this up? I will coordinate the external handoff and confirm acceptable redaction level.

Thanks,
Ethan Park
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192

----
Attachment: none

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping + tenant sample request

Ethan — noted. I will start the CAIQ workbook and follow this pattern:

- Column A: CAIQ question id / CCM control id
- Column B: Redwood control narrative (brief)
- Column C: Evidence artifact name (exact filename and path in internal repo)
- Column D: Evidence type (log/config/doc)
- Column E: Owner/TTL for when the artifact can be shared

Requests for artifact examples I need from infra/ops before I can finalize the evidence column: 
- Exact filename for key-rotation events in the repo (sys/auth/keystore/rotation-YYYYMM.log?)
- Naming convention for auth decision logs and path for the tenant sandbox used for sampling
- Confirmation whether KV-cache-access logs are retained for 30 days and where samples live

Marissa — can you prepare a short checklist for redaction rules (PII, tenant ids, IP redaction), and stage a sandbox export we can review? If Orchid will accept SHA256 hashes for long-lived keys instead of full key IDs that will speed delivery.

I will put a first draft of the CAIQ workbook into the shared drive and tag Ethan for review.

-Kim

----
Attachment: CAIQ_workbook_template.xlsm (internal stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Park <ethan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping + tenant sample request

Quick update — upload and handoff plan below:

- Sandbox export: created 2027-06-13 22:10 UTC; includes 60 minutes of telemetry from sandbox-tenant-17. Bundle contains: auth_decisions.log (redacted), key_rotation_events.log (hashed key ids), token_latency_trace.json (1-minute granularity aggregated by route).
- Redaction: tenant IDs replaced with tenant-X hash, IPs masked, user identifiers removed. PII removed per standard checklist.
- Storage: bundle uploaded to secure S3 pre-signed link (expires in 7 days). Link and CAIQ workbook draft are attached in the external handoff email.
- DocuSign: I generated a minimal NDA addendum; leaving it for Ethan to send externally (DocuSign link attached).

Attachments staged for external delivery: CAIQ_response_workbook_v0.3.xlsx, runtime-log-sample-bundle.tar.gz, docsign-orchid-link.txt

I will wait for final approval from Ethan before sending the link to Orchid.

Thanks — Marissa
Information Security Operations, Redwood Inference
----
Attachment: runtime-log-sample-bundle.tar.gz (stub)

From: Alex Nguyen <alex@orchidhealth.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@orchidhealth.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 16:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ mapping + tenant sample request

Ethan / team — this is great, thank you. We appreciate the redaction approach and the accelerated timeline. Two quick asks before we download:

1) Can you confirm that the token_latency_trace.json contains only aggregated traces and no raw prompt/response payloads?
2) For the CAIQ workbook, please add a short column that lists the expected control test steps Orchid will run (e.g., "verify key rotation timestamp present in key_rotation_events.log").

If you can include those two clarifications in the external handoff email, we can sign the addendum and pull the bundle later today.

Regards,
Alex
Security Team, Orchid Health
